Messages.Author: s bergmann
Messages.Body:
Quick one and if anyone else manages to get this to work well done.

Can i put a meddling in play targeting myself, then have my 2 vampires that
have legion on them take actions to create vamps.
Vamp 1 discards hand to make vamp.
Hand does not replace due to Meddling.
Vamp 2 takes action to make vamp using card in ash heap and discards hand, 0
cards.

is the second action legal even if you have no cards in hand? if so would
it also apply when your library is exusted?

Blood Brother Dave, trying to find a use for the legion.

Messages.Author: s bergmann
Messages.Body:
sorry about that meddling specifies select "other" meth.

sorry sorry sorry.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
s bergmann wrote:
> Quick one and if anyone else manages to get this to work well done.
>
>
> Can i put a meddling in play targeting myself, then have my 2 vampires that
> have legion on them take actions to create vamps.
> Vamp 1 discards hand to make vamp.
> Hand does not replace due to Meddling.
> Vamp 2 takes action to make vamp using card in ash heap and discards hand, 0
> cards.
>
> is the second action legal even if you have no cards in hand? if so would
> it also apply when your library is exusted?

As you note in your follow-up post, Meddling can only target others.
However, assuming someone else targets you with a Meddling, then you have
Vamp 1 and Vamp 2 act as you describe, yes. It is legal to discard the
"rest of your hand" when you have no cards in hand - the "rest of your
hand" in that case is simply zero cards. This also applies if your
library has been exhausted, yes.
